- Changed from truncating to **rounding** to the nearest cent
- Example: €119.99 yearly now shows €**10.00**/month (was €9.99)

**3. CLI support** (`bin/subtrack.js`)
- Added `--every week` flag alongside existing `--every month` and `--every year`

- **Upgrade function** (`src/store.js`): Fixed to preserve new cycle types (weekly) instead of converting everything to monthly
- **Export** (`src/export.js`): Updated to use `monthlyCents()` function for consistent rounding

**5. Tests updated** (`test/cycles.test.js`)
- Updated test expectations to match the new rounding behavior
